title: Effectivity of the explicit kernel construction
statement: For the explicit localSubobjectKernel and its canonical comparison [def-weil-pbc-proetale-local-subobject-kernel], if the monomorphisms q_i over a pro-etale cover [def-weil-pbc-proetale-covering] are isomorphic on overlaps by maps commuting with q_i, q_j and upperStarCompIso, every localSubobjectKernelComparison is an isomorphism. No new global object is chosen here.

lean.statement:
theorem isIso_localSubobjectKernelComparison
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (Q : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
    (U : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X)
    (L : ∀ i, Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology (U.X i)) Ab.{u + 1})
    (q : ∀ i, L i ⟶ (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (U.f i)).obj Q)
    (hq : ∀ i, Mono (q i))
    (hcompatible : ∀ i j, ∃ c :
      (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (pullback.fst (U.f i) (U.f j))).obj (L i) ≅
        (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (pullback.snd (U.f i) (U.f j))).obj (L j),
      c.hom ≫ (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (pullback.snd (U.f i) (U.f j))).map (q j) =
        (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (pullback.fst (U.f i) (U.f j))).map (q i) ≫
          (upperStarCompIso Ab.{u + 1}
            (pullback.condition (f := U.f i) (g := U.f j))).hom.app Q) :
    ∀ i, IsIso (localSubobjectKernelComparison X Q U L q hq i)
